notes.title: Version 1.5 | Return To Menu Sender Timer | Level 1 "Secrect Code" Updated
notes.notes:
Version 1.5 | Return To Menu Sender Timer | Level 1 Code Updated
1. When accessing the end of each level (finding the last VHS tape) will now toggle a timer that returns the player to menu. A UI text will appear letting the player know how much time is left.
2. Level 1 "secret 4 digit code" is now hidden in two places instead of one. (SPOILER: its found on the VHS tape and the Buddah statue now!)
